description: Parity ledger contract for the bundled-vs-hub answer-leg engine request (specs/artifacts/planning/engine-parity-instrument.md AC-3). Every JSON-path difference between the two captured requests must be listed here with a reason, or the diff fails. Shrinking this list is the refactoring driver.

documented_retrieval_divergence.reason: POST-CONSOLIDATION residuals only (both arms now select via querystore getContextSlice, ADR Decision 17; CP0-CP3 of querystore-context-slice-plan.md). The mandatory clinical core is a HARD equality gate in the diff, never excusable here. Two named, deliberate residual sources remain: (1) similarity-input drift — question interpretation is caller-side in v1, so bundled sends the stopword-stripped/panel-expanded question with its GP topK while the hub sends the raw question with the server default; (2) hub lexical union — the hub's exact/overlap tiers may add records beyond the slice for answer quality (roadmap: ranked candidates are additive, never a replacement). Measured 2026-07-22 post-CP3: 33v48, 42v85, 48v77 with bundled-only records 5/6/0 (all similarity-input drift). Shrinks further if v2 centralizes question interpretation.
